name: Spice Route
summary: A Karachi spice and dry fruit shop where each jar fills to the weight you pick and gift boxes pack jar by jar
about: A multi-page shop for whole and ground spices, dry fruit and aged basmati, in turmeric, paprika and charcoal on warm paper. Every product shows a glass jar that lifts its lid and fills to 250 g, 500 g or 1 kg as you choose, and the box builder flies each jar lid into its slot before the lid and ribbon close over it. Refills, recipe pairings, a bag that charges delivery by packed weight, checkout in PKR and live order tracking are all included.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Shop, Gift boxes, Refills, Recipes, Track order, your account or the bag
On a product page pick 250 g, 500 g or 1 kg and watch the jar fill while the price counts up; turn on a refill to save 10%
Filter the shop by aisle, origin, heat, price and tags, or press Ctrl+K to search products, recipes and orders
In the gift box builder choose 4, 6 or 9 jars and a box, tap spices to pack them, add a card note and close the lid
In the bag switch the delivery zone to see the scale and the weight-based delivery fee change, then check out with cash on delivery, bank transfer, card or wallet
Follow the order on the tracking page while the rider moves along the map
Reset the demo data in Account, under Settings
